class_name: 理由-因状況-イジョウハ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: now that; if it comes to
patterns.usage_note: Takes a fact the speaker has accepted and demands the resolve that ought to follow, so the second clause is typically a vow, an obligation, or an urging (引き受けたからには投げ出さない) rather than a neutral consequence. The front clause is normally something someone deliberately did or decided, which is why uncontrollable events like 雨が降るからには sound off; 以上は takes those. からにゃ is a rough spoken squeeze of からには, found in blunt speech and fiction dialogue.

examples.ruby: 引[ひ]き受[う]けたからにゃ、途中[とちゅう]で投[な]げ出[だ]すわけにはいかねえ。
examples.english: Now that I've taken it on, there's no way I'm dropping it halfway.

examples.ruby: 金[かね]を取[と]るからにゃ、半端[はんぱ]な仕事[しごと]はできねえ。
examples.english: If I'm charging money for it, I can't very well do a half-baked job.

examples.ruby: 試合[しあい]に出[で]るからにゃ、負[ま]けて帰[かえ]るつもりはねえ。
examples.english: If I'm playing in this match, I've no intention of going home a loser.

glosses: now that; since; as long as
patterns.usage_note: Marks a fact the speaker consciously acknowledges, and the clause that follows states the responsibility, resolve, or judgment that falls out of it (医者に止められた以上は酒は控える). It is the flexible sibling: からには wants a course of action someone chose, while 以上は also accepts circumstances nobody chose (雨で中止になった以上は), and 上は belongs to formal writing and speeches. It attaches to nouns and な-adjectives through である (学生である以上は).

examples.ruby: 親[おや]が反対[はんたい]している以上[いじょう]は、今[いま]は動[うご]けない。
examples.english: As long as my parents are against it, I can't make a move.

examples.ruby: 医者[いしゃ]に止[と]められた以上[いじょう]は、酒[さけ]は控[ひか]えるべきだ。
examples.english: Now that the doctor has told me to stop, I really ought to lay off the drink.

examples.ruby: 日本[にほん]で暮[く]らす以上[いじょう]は、地震[じしん]に備[そな]えておこう。
examples.english: If we're going to live in Japan, let's be ready for earthquakes.

patterns.usage_note: Names a commitment or a situation the speaker treats as already sealed, and the main clause states what one is now bound to do or the single course left, with a note of burnt bridges. 以上は takes a neutral premise as readily and has largely displaced 上は outside speeches, editorials, and narration. かくなる上は and the past-form こうなった上は are its signature openings; with a non-past verb it is easily misread as the unrelated 〜する上で, "in the course of doing".

examples.ruby: かくなる上[うえ]は、正面[しょうめん]から戦[たたか]うほかあるまい。
examples.english: It having come to this, there is nothing left but to fight them head-on.

examples.ruby: この道[みち]を選[えら]ぶ上[うえ]は、もう後戻[あともど]りはできない。
examples.english: Having chosen this road, there is no turning back now.

examples.ruby: 一国[いっこく]を率[ひき]いる上[うえ]は、私情[しじょう]を挟[はさ]む余地[よち]はない。
examples.english: In leading a nation, there is no room for personal feeling.
